Definition: Bosmath, the name of a wife of Esau, and of a daughter of Solomon
BiblicalUsage: Bashemath or Basmath = "spice"; 1) Hittite wife of Esau, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth; 2) daughter of Solomon, wife of Ahimaaz, one of Solomon's commissariat officers
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
